title: ai.qory.run.policy_applied
description: The policy the run is pinned to, as read once before the runtime started, and the effective allow list after the declared egress narrowed it.

allow.description: The effective allow list: the policy's entries, or when a declaration was given, the declared entries the policy covers.

source.description: file when a policy file was read; none when there was none and the runner observes everything.

path.description: The policy file, when source is file.

digest.description: sha256 of the policy file's bytes, hex, when source is file; the version stamp of the run's policy.

declared.description: The egress the harness declared, as handed to the runner, when it was.
